# Repository Initialization

The `init_repository` function initializes a new repository by upgrading the schema, registering the repository with its configuration, and returning the repository ID along with the path to the configuration file. This enables the repository to be correctly set up for use within the Knowledge Compiler framework.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.init_repository`
